observations.label: help
observations.stdout:
usage: csv_summarizer.py [-h] --column NAME INPUT

Count CSV data records and print exact totals for selected numeric columns,
offline.

positional arguments:
  INPUT          local comma-delimited CSV file with a header

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --column NAME  numeric header name after trimming outer header whitespace;
                 repeat for multiple totals

Use comma-delimited UTF-8 CSV with a unique nonblank header (optional BOM).
Repeat --column for each numeric column; other columns may contain text.
Numbers are signed plain decimals, up to 18 integer and 12 fractional digits
including zeros; no grouping, currency symbols or exponent notation. Header-
only files yield zero totals; empty files and blank records are errors. Inputs
are never modified. Example: csv_summarizer.py sample.csv --column amount
--column quantity
